overall: Los Angeles is experiencing a classic marine layer morning for the Fourth of July, with patchy fog keeping temperatures suppressed in the low-to-mid 60s through 09:45 ET. Peak is expected around mid-afternoon (~14–17h local time) as the marine layer clears.
